name: Universal Logistics - GM Arlington Logistics Center - Grand Prairie TX

fieldNotes.facility: Universal Logistics value-added logistics / sub-assembly center serving GM Arlington Assembly (Tahoe/Suburban/Yukon/Escalade), at 2305 W Marshall Dr, Grand Prairie TX, inside the Great Southwest Industrial District. A ~1.2M sq ft campus: a long N-S main warehouse with dock doors on both long faces plus a second blue-roofed building at the north end. Confirmed via TruckMap/Waze ('Universal & GM'), Panjiva shipper records ('GM Arlington (Universal Logistics)'), and 2022 Street View showing Universal-branded trailers backed in at the docks.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Open speculative-build industrial-park campus — 2022 Street View shows the dock aprons on both faces of the building open directly to the campus drives with NO perimeter fence, NO barrier arm/gate, and NO checkpoint structure. Trucks drive straight from W Marshall Dr onto the dock apron. Matches the 'No Gate / No GS' archetype.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth anywhere on the site.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: The long main building has continuous dock-door banks on BOTH its east and west long faces (trailers backed in along both), plus dock doors on the second building -> very high total, estimated ~120-140 -> 50+ band.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on two physically separate building faces (east face and west face) -> shipping and receiving can run from separate clusters.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Some trailer-parking rows on the west side beyond the dock apron, but most parked trailers are dock-staged at doors; modest dedicated drop space -> 10-25 band. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropYard: No large dedicated standalone trailer-storage lot separate from dock staging -> false.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Two-building campus — the long main warehouse plus a second (blue-roofed) building at the north end.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Open apron directly off the public drive — no deep gated approach; the staging is the apron itself -> drivewayShort.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense Dallas-Fort Worth metro industrial fabric (Great Southwest Industrial District) -> Urban.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property -> false.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~62 acres for the two-building campus parcel including dock aprons and parking.
